Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Case 64, match 2393228. Head means of spatial attention at the final real timestep. The middle column shows a learned per-head negative bias strength multiplying fixed normalized centroid distances. The right column removes that local bias with Q/K held fixed; it is not the full-model bypass intervention. All heads are retained in the source tensors. Attention is a mechanism trace, not causal attribution.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Case 64: last-query temporal attention over the entire sampled prefix, summed into fixed 5-second bins and averaged over heads. The displayed range ends at the observed cutoff; boundary bins can contain less than 5 seconds of observations. Negative time is buy phase. Original token weights and timestamps are saved. This is not an attention rollout or evidence-importance score.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Linear CKA uses corresponding per-cutoff region-mean layer states, with state 0 before the first block. t-SNE shows independently projected vanilla and structured final embeddings, projection seed 17/perplexity 30 (other settings are saved as stability coordinates). Target labels color points only and do not fit the projection. Projection appearance alone cannot establish improved tactical representations.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Final-timestep temporal gate modulation, measured as channel RMS deviation from unity, for the most frequent public population pair CT=5, T=5. Gate=0.5+sigmoid lies in (0.5,1.5), scales only the temporal update, and is not a modality probability. RMS does not distinguish amplification from attenuation. Region-cutoff means are averaged equally over supporting matches; cells with <2 matches or <5 region-cutoffs are gray. Category labels give region-cutoffs / supporting matches. Missing audio is excluded from footstep contexts. Exact per-cell support is in B1_source.csv. These are conditional associations, not effects of changing tactics.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Final-timestep output-projected residual updates, including tanh(scale) and the temporal gate. Each update is normalized by its own immediately preceding state RMS, epsilon=1e-8. Left: equal-match mean, after within-cutoff region averaging. Right: predefined case 64. Norm ratios do not add as causal contributions because update vectors can cancel.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Frozen-checkpoint computational interventions on 128 identical cutoffs from 14 matches. All weights, inputs, full histories and modalities stay fixed. Each point is one match mean; Δ=intervened−ordinary, so positive values mean the original mechanism gives lower NLL. All signs are retained. This is a sensitivity probe, not a retrained ablation or a causal effect of gameplay changes. Match IDs map in lexicographic order to M1... in interventions.csv.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Full held-out predictions restricted to n=3 hidden alive enemies: 3462 cutoffs from 14 matches. Each matrix is an equal-match mean of pair-presence probabilities. Diagonal entries are marginal presence. Residual matrices are aggregate agreement diagnostics, not sufficient proof of calibration; pair-presence Brier and reliability data are also saved. Baseline=vanilla_transformer; encoder differs, so effects cannot be attributed to the decoder alone. A multinomial actor model already has dependent region counts due to fixed population; it is not independent region counts.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Discrete two-region predictive laws estimated from 256 draws per cutoff. a: case 64, R8/R6, n=2; b: case 232, R7/R5, n=1; c: case 1, R8/R10, n=2; d: case 8, R8/R4, n=3. Within each predefined case, the two regions with greatest predictive count variance are selected without using the outcome. Cross marks the single observed realization, not a true conditional distribution. Gray cells are structurally impossible (sum>n); an estimated zero in a possible cell can be Monte Carlo sampling zero. Common [0,1] probability scale.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Predefined cases [64, 232, 1]: predictive mean (top), predictive count standard deviation (middle), and observed target counts (bottom) at training-fitted region centroids. Shared row color limits use the displayed cases' theoretical support: count 0–2, SD 0–1. Region numbers are annotated. This is a 2D projection in original game units. If present, the gray backdrop is empirical training-trajectory density only; it is not a navigation mesh, complete walkability map or reconstructed scene. No test trajectories construct that backdrop. Region predictions are not spatially interpolated. The predictive sample count is 256.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Population-conditioned regional readout for predefined cases [64, 232, 1, 8]; head-mean attention minus the uniform 1/K reference, with shared symmetric color limits ±0.6191. Each query accesses the final real-time region tokens produced from the entire observed prefix. These are teacher-forced likelihood diagnostics: earlier region allocations use the observed target counts, not information given to deployed inference. Gray rows have zero remaining population and a deterministic zero count; the final region is determined by conservation and has no decoder query. Raw per-head weights, conditional probabilities and remaining counts are saved. Attention alone does not prove predictive benefit.

Validation-selected epoch 5 checkpoint after 13 completed training epochs; prespecified representative training seed 2026; 256 diagnostic cutoffs from 14 held-out matches. Diagnostic cutoffs were prespecified by live time and match-balanced, without selecting successful predictions. Overlapping prefixes are not independent replicates. Left: frozen checkpoint readout bypass on 128 identical cutoffs from 14 matches, holding every input, weight and modality fixed. Positive means the active readout gives lower exact NLL; all match signs are shown. Right: actual tanh-scaled update added to the decoder input, measured by channel RMS during the teacher-forced diagnostics in D1. Gray cells have no remaining mass. Update magnitude and frozen sensitivity are mechanism checks, not retrained benefits or game-level causal effects.

selection: at most two nearest cutoffs to 20/60 live seconds per round, match-balanced seeded subsample; cases use input context/population, never prediction quality
projection_stability: 2 seeds × 2 perplexities, cached independently for every available model
aggregation: within-match mean then equal-weight mean across matches; no token-level independent replication
